issues.title: External Dependency Missing
issues.why: The module relies heavily on §07 (Core Design System) for primitives, but the content of §07 is not provided in the context, making it impossible to verify if --background or --card actually exist.
issues.fix: Provide the core design system tokens from spec/07-design-system/ in the context.

issues.title: Z-Index Collision Risk
issues.why: The AppShell uses hardcoded z-40 and z-30. If §07 defines a global z-index scale (e.g., for modals or tooltips), these hardcoded values may cause layering bugs.
issues.fix: Map z-index values to §07 tokens (e.g., z-[var(--z-sticky)]) instead of raw Tailwind classes.

issues.title: Sidebar Transition State
issues.why: The spec defines a collapsed state for < md breakpoints but does not specify if the transition should be animated or how 'icons only' mode handles labels for a11y.
issues.fix: Add a 'Transitions' section to the AppShell contract specifying duration and easing.
